# edgeos_system_offload (Resource)

Hardware offload settings (`system offload`). There is one per router; the resource takes over the existing node.

Which knobs do anything depends on the hardware:

- MediaTek models (EdgeRouter X, X SFP, 10X and EdgePoint R6): `hwnat` and `ipsec`.
- Cavium models (EdgeRouter Lite, PoE, 4, 6P, 12, Pro, 8-XG, Infinity): the `ipv4_*` and `ipv6_*` knobs and `ipsec`.

EdgeOS accepts every knob on every model, so the provider cannot tell you that a knob does nothing on yours. Some offload changes only take effect after a reboot, and the provider never reboots the router.

Only the attributes you set are managed; the rest of `system offload` is neither read nor changed. Removing an attribute from the configuration removes that node from the router, and destroying the resource removes every node it manages, so EdgeOS falls back to its default for the model. Import reads every attribute.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# EdgeRouter X family (MediaTek): hardware NAT.
resource "edgeos_system_offload" "this" {
  hwnat = true
}

# On a Cavium model (EdgeRouter Lite, 4, 6P, 12, ...) use the ipv4/ipv6 knobs
# instead:
#
# resource "edgeos_system_offload" "this" {
#   ipv4_forwarding = true
#   ipv4_vlan       = true
#   ipv4_pppoe      = true
#   ipv6_forwarding = true
#   ipv6_vlan       = true
#   ipsec           = true
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `hwnat` (Boolean) Hardware NAT and forwarding offload (`hwnat`). MediaTek models (EdgeRouter X, X SFP, 10X and EdgePoint R6) only. `true` writes `enable`, `false` writes `disable`, unset leaves it alone.
- `ipsec` (Boolean) IPsec ESP offload (`ipsec`). Cavium and MediaTek models. `true` writes `enable`, `false` writes `disable`, unset leaves it alone.
- `ipv4_bonding` (Boolean) IPv4 offload for bonded interfaces (`ipv4 bonding`). Cavium models only. `true` writes `enable`, `false` writes `disable`, unset leaves it alone.
- `ipv4_forwarding` (Boolean) IPv4 forwarding offload (`ipv4 forwarding`). Cavium models (EdgeRouter Lite, PoE, 4, 6P, 12, Pro, 8-XG, Infinity) only. `true` writes `enable`, `false` writes `disable`, unset leaves it alone.
- `ipv4_gre` (Boolean) IPv4 offload for GRE tunnels (`ipv4 gre`). Cavium models only. `true` writes `enable`, `false` writes `disable`, unset leaves it alone.
- `ipv4_pppoe` (Boolean) IPv4 offload for PPPoE interfaces (`ipv4 pppoe`). Cavium models only. `true` writes `enable`, `false` writes `disable`, unset leaves it alone.
- `ipv4_vlan` (Boolean) IPv4 offload for VLAN interfaces (`ipv4 vlan`). Cavium models only. `true` writes `enable`, `false` writes `disable`, unset leaves it alone.
- `ipv6_bonding` (Boolean) IPv6 offload for bonded interfaces (`ipv6 bonding`). Cavium models only. `true` writes `enable`, `false` writes `disable`, unset leaves it alone.
- `ipv6_forwarding` (Boolean) IPv6 forwarding offload (`ipv6 forwarding`). Cavium models only. `true` writes `enable`, `false` writes `disable`, unset leaves it alone.
- `ipv6_pppoe` (Boolean) IPv6 offload for PPPoE interfaces (`ipv6 pppoe`). Cavium models only. `true` writes `enable`, `false` writes `disable`, unset leaves it alone.
- `ipv6_vlan` (Boolean) IPv6 offload for VLAN interfaces (`ipv6 vlan`). Cavium models only. `true` writes `enable`, `false` writes `disable`, unset leaves it alone.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `offload`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = edgeos_system_offload.this
  id = "offload"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import edgeos_system_offload.this 'offload'
```
